类 CompoundType.Member

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.rmi.rmic.iiop.CompoundType.Member
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Cloneable, ContextElement
    封闭类:
    CompoundType

    public class CompoundType.Member
extends Object
implements ContextElement, Cloneable
    An CompoundType.Member object wraps a Type and a value representing a data member, including constants.
